exposure: Prospective revised design; no follow-up battle has been captured. Original1I+240L/125I predicted Infantry first absent on turn4, after3 normal attacks. That invalidates the initial assumption that after3-normal cannot prime a delayed protection effect. Original assets are preserved unmodified; the revised formation is1I+480L versus250I and requires source death before3 attacks in both traces.
reason: Discriminate protection after Infantry die from a battle-start-only Infantry requirement. Larger opponent is chosen to kill the one Infantry before it can prime a3-normal trigger, preserving full actual kit and known stats.

hypotheses.current: Fixed-turn protection continues when a previously present Infantry line dies; equivalent to a battle-start-only source requirement in this formation.

Attack-trigger alternatives with3 or4 required Infantry normal attacks also produce no S1 here.
